Parameter.name: tc_ack_apid
Parameter.shortDescription: request ID: APID of the TC

Parameter.name: tc_ack_seq
Parameter.shortDescription: request ID: sequence count of the TC

Parameter.name: sec_challenge
Parameter.shortDescription: SEQ the next recovery command must carry

Parameter.name: sec_flag_slot1_untrusted
Parameter.shortDescription: slot 1 counter untrusted: FIRST CONTACT needed (RECOVERY_SET_COUNTER)

SequenceContainer.name: hk_sid2_essential
SequenceContainer.shortDescription: HK SID 2, essential, SAFE mode (fdir6.c hk_essential)

MetaCommand.name: lotus1_tc
MetaCommand.shortDescription: Session 8 PUS-C telecommand to APID 0x010. The ground security unit (bridge) adds SPI, SEQ and MAC.

MetaCommand.name: PING
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(17,1) are-you-alive

MetaCommand.name: SET_MODE
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(8,1) function 1: request a vehicle mode (executed at the next 2 s supervisor cycle: wait for Mode_Reached, not only Complete, NCR-01)

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(8,1) function 2: payload ON or OFF. ON is refused (TM(1,8)) outside NOMINAL; SAFE clears it; DEGRADED suspends it

MetaCommand.name: SCHED_ENABLE
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(11,1) enable the time based schedule

MetaCommand.name: SCHED_DISABLE
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(11,2) disable the schedule

MetaCommand.name: SCHED_RESET
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(11,3) delete every scheduled activity

MetaCommand.name: MONITOR_ENABLE
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(12,1) enable one parameter monitor

MetaCommand.name: MONITOR_DISABLE
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(12,2) disable one parameter monitor

MetaCommand.name: FDIR_ENABLE
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(19,8) FDIR actions on

MetaCommand.name: FDIR_INHIBIT
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(19,9) inhibit FDIR actions for a time

MetaCommand.name: LOAD_KEY
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(210,1) load a new key into an INACTIVE slot. The ground security unit generates the key and wraps it (AES-128-CCM); key material never enters the MCS. Compare SID 3 KCV with the bridge log before ACTIVATE.

DefaultSignificance.reasonForWarning: TC(210,1) load a new key into an INACTIVE slot. The ground security unit generates the key and wraps it (AES-128-CCM); key material never enters the MCS. Compare SID 3 KCV with the bridge log before ACTIVATE.

MetaCommand.name: ACTIVATE_KEY
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(210,2) make a LOADED slot the active key

DefaultSignificance.reasonForWarning: TC(210,2) make a LOADED slot the active key

MetaCommand.name: ERASE_KEY
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(210,3) zeroise an inactive slot

MetaCommand.name: RECOVERY_SET_COUNTER
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(210,10) RECOVERY KEY: set a slot's anti-replay counter. floor 0 = the security unit's safe floor (above every value ever used).

MetaCommand.name: RECOVERY_ACTIVATE
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TC(210,11) RECOVERY KEY: activate a LOADED spare slot when the active key is lost

MetaCommand.name: TEST_INJECT_PARAM
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TEST BUILD ONLY: TC(200,1) force a sensor value

MetaCommand.name: TEST_INJECT_CLEAR
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TEST BUILD ONLY: TC(200,4) clear injections

MetaCommand.name: TEST_SEC_COUNTER
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TEST BUILD ONLY: TC(211,1) overwrite counter copies (upset)

MetaCommand.name: TEST_SEC_KEY_FLIP
MetaCommand.shortDescription: TEST BUILD ONLY: TC(211,2) flip key bits in the copies set in 'copies' (bit 0 = the copy used for MACs)
